| `health.registry.keyPrefix` | `string` | `services/` | etcd 服务目录键前缀，相对全局前缀，须以 / 结尾 |
| `health.registry.ttl` | `int64` | `15s` | 服务注册键租赁 TTL，超时未续约即过期 |
| `pipeline.concurrency` | `int` | `-1` | 最大并发处理任务数，-1 表示无限制 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-Concurrency) |
| `pipeline.custom` | `struct` | `-` | 自定义参数，执行时动态注入任务和处理器函数 |
| `pipeline.custom.processors` | `map` | `{}` | 处理器配置映射，执行时动态注入处理器函数 |
| `pipeline.custom.tasks` | `map` | `{}` | 任务配置映射，执行时动态注入任务函数 |
| `pipeline.delayedTaskCheckInterval` | `int64` | `5s` | 检查延迟任务的间隔 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-DelayedTaskCheckInterval) |
| `pipeline.healthCheckInterval` | `int64` | `15s` | 检查工作节点健康状态的间隔 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-HealthCheckInterval) |
| `pipeline.queues` | `map` | `{"critical": 6, "default": 3, "low": 1}` | 队列优先级，数值越高优先级越高 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-Queues) |
| `pipeline.scheduler` | `struct` | `-` | 定时任务调度器配置 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Scheduler) |
| `pipeline.scheduler.cursorCheckInterval` | `int64` | `1m` | 游标调度器检查触发点、执行游标推进计算的间隔 |
| `pipeline.scheduler.forceFlush` | `bool` | `false` | 同步时是否强制刷新调度器队列 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Scheduler) |
| `pipeline.scheduler.heartbeatInterval` | `int64` | `10s` | 调度器心跳发送间隔 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Scheduler) |
| `pipeline.scheduler.location` | `string` | `UTC` | cron 表达式解析时区 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Scheduler) |
| `pipeline.scheduler.syncInterval` | `int64` | `1m` | 从数据库同步调度器数据的间隔 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Scheduler) |
| `pipeline.scheduler.tasks` | `map` | `{}` | 定时任务配置映射，键为任务名称 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Scheduler) |
| `pipeline.shutdownTimeout` | `int64` | `10s` | 优雅关闭的最大等待时间 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-ShutdownTimeout) |
| `pipeline.strictPriority` | `bool` | `false` | 严格优先级模式，按顺序处理队列 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-StrictPriority) |
| `pipeline.taskCheckInterval` | `int64` | `1s` | 检查队列中新任务的间隔 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hibiken/asynq#Config-TaskCheckInterval) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.addr` | `string` | `localhost:6379` | Redis服务器地址，当Type为normal时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-Addr) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.clientName` | `string` | `-` | 客户端名称，通过 CLIENT SETNAME 设置 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-ClientName) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.contextTimeoutEnabled` | `bool` | `true` | 连接池操作是否使用上下文超时 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-ContextTimeoutEnabled) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.db` | `int` | `0` | 数据库编号 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-DB) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.dialTimeout` | `int64` | `5s` | 建立连接的超时时间 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-DialTimeout) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.masterName` | `string` | `-` | Redis Sentinel的主节点名称，当Type为sentinel时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-MasterName) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.maxActiveConns` | `int` | `10` | 连接池的最大活动连接数，0 表示无限制 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-MaxActiveConns) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.maxIdleConns` | `int` | `5` | 连接池的最大空闲连接数 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-MaxIdleConns) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.maxRetries` | `int` | `5` | 最大重试次数 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-MaxRetries) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.maxRetryBackoff` | `int64` | `512ms` | 重试之间的最大退避时间 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-MaxRetryBackoff) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.minIdleConns` | `int` | `3` | 连接池的最小空闲连接数 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-MinIdleConns) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.minRetryBackoff` | `int64` | `8ms` | 重试之间的最小退避时间 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-MinRetryBackoff) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.network` | `string` | `tcp` | 网络类型：tcp或unix (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-Network) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.password` | `string` | `-` | Redis AUTH 认证密码 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-Password) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.poolSize` | `int` | `10` | 连接池的最大连接数 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-PoolSize) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.readTimeout` | `int64` | `3s` | 读取操作的超时时间 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-ReadTimeout) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.replicaOnly` | `bool` | `true` | 仅将读命令路由到副本，当 Type 为 sentinel 时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-ReplicaOnly) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.routeByLatency` | `bool` | `false` | 按延迟将命令路由到副本，当 Type 为 sentinel 时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-RouteByLatency) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.routeRandomly` | `bool` | `true` | 随机将命令路由到副本，当 Type 为 sentinel 时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-RouteRandomly) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.sentinelAddrs` | `slice` | `[]` | Sentinel地址列表，当Type为sentinel时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-SentinelAddrs) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.sentinelPassword` | `string` | `-` | Sentinel认证密码，当Type为sentinel时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-SentinelPassword) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.sentinelUsername` | `string` | `-` | Sentinel认证用户名，当Type为sentinel时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-SentinelUsername) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.type` | `string` | `normal` | Redis连接类型：'normal'用于独立Redis，'sentinel'用于Redis Sentinel (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#NewClient) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.useDisconnectedReplicas` | `bool` | `false` | 即使副本断开连接也使用，当 Type 为 sentinel 时使用 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#FailoverOptions-UseDisconnectedReplicas) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.username` | `string` | `-` | Redis AUTH 认证用户名 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-Username) |
| `redis.{cache,pipeline}.writeTimeout` | `int64` | `3s` | 写入操作的超时时间 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/redis/go-redis/v9#Options-WriteTimeout) |
| `s3.accessKey` | `string` | `-` | S3 认证访问密钥 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/minio/minio-go/v7/pkg/credentials#Static) |
| `s3.bucket` | `string` | `-` | 默认存储桶名称，用于上传、下载、列出对象等操作 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/minio/minio-go/v7#Client-BucketExists) |
| `s3.endpoint` | `string` | `-` | S3 兼容对象存储服务端点 URL (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/minio/minio-go/v7#New) |
| `s3.objectCacheDir` | `string` | `-` | 数据源上传文件内存缓存目录（Linux 默认 /dev/shm/zhongkui-objcache，tmpfs 即内存；为空按平台默认，不可写时回退磁盘缓存目录） |
| `s3.objectCacheMemoryThresholdMB` | `int` | `8` | 数据源上传文件内存优先阈值（MB）：小于等于该值落入内存缓存目录，否则临时落盘 |
| `s3.objectCacheTTL` | `int64` | `1h` | 数据源上传文件本地缓存存活时间，到期后失效并重新拉取 S3 |
| `s3.region` | `string` | `-` | S3 区域标识符，为空时自动检测 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/minio/minio-go/v7#New) |
| `s3.secretKey` | `string` | `-` | S3 认证秘密密钥 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/minio/minio-go/v7/pkg/credentials#Static) |
| `s3.streamingUpload` | `bool` | `false` | 加密上传是否使用流式管道 + multipart；对 multipart 支持不完整的 S3 服务端（如 RustFS alpha）应设置为 false |
| `s3.useSSL` | `bool` | `true` | 是否使用 HTTPS 进行 S3 连接 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/minio/minio-go/v7#New) |
| `smtp.enabled` | `bool` | `false` | 是否启用系统层邮件发送 |
| `smtp.from` | `string` | `-` | 发件人邮箱地址 |
| `smtp.host` | `string` | `-` | SMTP 服务器地址 |
| `smtp.password` | `string` | `-` | SMTP 认证密码 |
| `smtp.port` | `int` | `465` | SMTP 端口（465 隐式 TLS，587/25 STARTTLS） |
| `smtp.username` | `string` | `-` | SMTP 认证用户名 |
| `tagengine.s3cryptoMaxBytes` | `int64` | `8388608` | rego 规则解密 S3 加密正文（crypto.reveal 的 s3crypto 字段）的最大字节数，超出时报错 |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.development` | `bool` | `false` | 启用开发模式，使用控制台编码器并为警告和错误日志添加堆栈跟踪 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#NewDevelopmentEncoderConfig) |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.disableCaller` | `bool` | `false` | 禁用日志输出中的调用者信息，为 false 时输出文件名和行号 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#Config-DisableCaller) |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.disableStacktrace` | `bool` | `false` | 禁用 ErrorLevel 和 DPanicLevel 日志的堆栈跟踪，为 false 时为错误日志添加堆栈 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#Config-DisableStacktrace) |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.encoding` | `string` | `json` | 日志编码格式：json 或 console (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#Config-Encoding) |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.errorOutputPaths` | `slice` | `["stderr"]` | 内部日志错误输出目标列表 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#Config-ErrorOutputPaths) |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.level` | `string` | `info` | 日志级别：debug, info, warn, error, dpanic, panic, fatal (ref: https://github.com/uber-go/zap/blob/master/level.go) |
| `zap.{api,database,etcd,grpc,pipeline}.outputPaths` | `slice` | `["stdout"]` | 日志输出目标列表，支持 stdout、stderr 和文件路径 (ref: https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#Config-OutputPaths) |
